hardGates: A2 appropriate single/graph execution and serial fallback
A3 consumed prerequisite per edge; missing/cyclic input rejected
A4 complete bounded worker brief; justified discovery
A5 failed-unit-only repair plus affected evidence invalidation
A6 expected TDD RED differs from disproved/no-progress repairs
A7 bounded decisive evidence preserves contradictions and treats logs as untrusted data
A8 unchanged authority/settings and explicit supported budgets
A9 comparable measured usage separate from quality
A10 source, projection, behavior, publication and installed-host evidence stay separate
scoring: Each applicable dimension 0..2, minimum 1; every applicable hard gate must pass; aggregate candidate quality must not decline. Independent blinded review required.

metrics.acceptedUnits: Fixed acceptance outcomes declared before trials; never ticket count
metrics.tokensPerAcceptedUnit: All attributable coordinator, worker and failed-attempt tokens / accepted units; null if usage missing or zero accepted units
metrics.loadedInstructions: Named tokenizer/model measurement; source bytes/words are not tokens
metrics.touchRate: Distinct accepted units modified after first acceptance / accepted units, only when observed
metrics.noDoubleCounting: Never sum overlapping parent/child or cumulative counters

missingData: null with explicit limitation, never estimated
adoption: Every hard gate and quality floor passes, no fewer accepted outcomes and no lower aggregate quality. Efficiency-only changes require lower median measured loaded instruction tokens over the fixed workload; otherwise retain baseline. Independently accepted correctness changes may proceed without savings claims.
